name: Muha Meds Live Resin Disposable | Super Lemon Haze
description: Super Lemon Haze, or SLH, is a potent sativa that has earned its reputation as a two-time Cannabis Cup winner. It is a fusion of Lemon Skunk and Super Silver Haze, delivering on its promise of lemony goodness. With a zesty, citrusy, and slightly sweet aroma, the taste mirrors its namesake, reminiscent of tart and sweet lemonhead candy. What sets Super Lemon Haze apart are its unique effects, which provide an energetic and lively experience. This strain is an ideal choice for those seeking a burst of vibrant energy and creativity.
